text:
I came into Parramatta Sephora to exchange 2 of the items I lightly tried on, but didn’t match my skin tone, and to refund the 3 items I haven’t opened.

I was having difficulty looking for a particular brand, so I approached a worker named Georgia, I asked if she worked there, she said she did, but was serving another customer. Understandable although I just wanted to be pointed in the direction of a brand I was looking for.

Jess was incredible and helped me with finding a few of the items on my list, as well as recommending similar products to the ones that were unfortunately out of stock in-store, her customer service was amazing and should be recognised and appreciated.

Although upon checking out, I was humiliated and disgusted with the service of TAMARA S serving me at the register. I’ve been shopping at Sephora at Pitt St for the past few weeks and even left them an amazing review for their hard work and dedication in providing outstanding customer service, but this is the first time I came across a Sephora worker who obviously looked like she hated her job, didn’t want to be there and didn’t want to serve anyone, as well as immediately giving attitude, rolling her eyes, belittling me with snarky comments, and didn’t know what she was doing.

I simply wanted to exchange the items I purchased, both lightly used and unopened products I purchased 2 days ago at Pitt St with the products I was able to find in store that were out of stock in Pitt St. Tamara S asked if I wanted the remaining funds as a store credit or refunded to my card, I asked for it to be refunded to my card. She then refused to refund me the remaining funds, and proceeded to explain because I opened 2 out of the 5 products purchased, she can only give me a store credit. I asked for my receipt back, to ask if I can have the 3 products I unopened back, as I might as well keep them and pay the remaining amount due for the items I wanted to exchange. She then rolled her eyes as I asked for the receipt and products back then insulted me by saying I had an attitude, when I only asked for the items I paid for already to be returned to me.

Me and my partner was appalled, completely shocked, felt disrespected and humiliated. When she started putting through the other items, she was taking a while and the line was piling up behind us, she looked like she had no idea what she was doing and later left to ask another co-worker for help. When she left my partner was still shocked and humiliated after her comment and suggested to get the opened items store credited and the unopened items refunded instead of purchasing/ exchanging the items we had brought to the counter, as he didn’t want to spend money on that Sephora store specifically after encountering such disgusting service.

I’ve only ever written good reviews, as I previously was a store manager for 4 years and do Mystery Shopper on the side, and understand good customer service and store policy protocols. I believe people who are dedicated in providing outstanding customer service and representing the company in a positive manner deserve recognition. I frequently shop and spend hundreds of dollars at a time at Sephora at Pitt St, as I work in the city, and have always received excellent customer service from Nana, Sarah, Cindy and the rest of the girls there and always left happy and satisfied.

Customers expect to at least receive the bare minimum service when spending their hardworking money at a reputable luxury beauty company. It really takes one person in the company to ruin its reputation, I highly suggest reviewing Tamara S and her work values as well as her people skills and customer service.
